title_ja: ElevenLabsの音声API、読み上げ・声クローン・吹き替えを同一基盤で——多言語ナレーション工程を短縮
summary_ja: ElevenLabsはテキスト読み上げ、声のクローン、動画吹き替えを一つのプラットフォームで扱えるAI音声サービスだ。話者の声質や感情のニュアンスを細かく指定でき、数十言語への展開も同じワークフローで進められる。動画・ポッドキャスト・アプリに音声を載せる個人開発者や制作チームにとって、TTSベンダーを渡り歩く手間を減らし、ブランドの声を一貫させたまま反復できるのが実務上の利点になる。

en.title: ElevenLabs packs TTS, voice cloning, and dubbing into one API that shortens multilingual narration work
en.summary: ElevenLabs is an AI speech platform that combines text-to-speech, voice cloning, and video dubbing so teams do not need a separate vendor for each step. Creators can specify speaker timbre and emotional nuance, then reuse the same voice across dozens of languages without rebuilding the pipeline. That matters for indie developers and production teams shipping narration in apps, podcasts, and short-form video, where fragmented TTS tools create handoffs and inconsistent brand sound. Practically, you generate, iterate, and localize from one workflow instead of gluing APIs together. If you are choosing voice infrastructure for a product—not just trying a demo—ElevenLabs is a builder-facing option for collapsing multilingual audio into a single stack.
